findings.claim: The comparison cannot detect submodules under tools/ that are missing from versions.toml, so the gate can pass with an incomplete version authority.
findings.evidence: Spec requirement says versions.toml "SHALL name, for every submodule under `tools/`, the commit the parent repository's gitlink pins"; compareToTree only iterates `Object.entries(parsed.submodules ?? {})` and has no API to enumerate existing tools/ gitlinks, while `rules/test/versions-toml.test.mjs` only separately asserts `tools/prometheus-knowledge` can be found.
findings.suggested_fix: Inject the list of gitlinks under tools/ into compareToTree or the gate test, and report any gitlink path absent from `[submodules]`.

findings.claim: The archived change is still present as an active change, so it was duplicated rather than archived out of openspec/changes.
findings.evidence: Acceptance 1.2 requires archiving `analyze-rust-tools-windows-portability` and confirming `openspec list` no longer shows it; the diff adds both `openspec/changes/analyze-rust-tools-windows-portability/*` and `openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-22-analyze-rust-tools-windows-portability/*`.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `openspec/changes/analyze-rust-tools-windows-portability/` from the active changes tree, leaving only the archived copy.
